privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What Game Shelfed knows about you, why, and how to delete all of it.
privacy.contactText: Questions about your data go here:

sections.title: What we store
text: For your account: username, email and a hash of your password, so we never see the password itself. If you sign in with Steam, we store your Steam ID, profile name and avatar.
Your shelf: games, statuses, ratings, playtime, sale threshold and comments.
If you turn on notifications, your browser hands us a push address. We keep it until you turn them off.

sections.title: Visit stats
text: To count visitors, your browser gets a random ID in localStorage. With it we record the page, where you came from (a site or an ad tag), your browser and device type, and the country our host derives from your IP. The IP address itself is not stored.
If you arrive through an ad link, your browser remembers its tag for 30 days. When you sign up, the tag is saved with your account so we can see which ad worked.

sections.title: Ads and cookies
text: The site sets no cookies of its own: sign-in uses a token in localStorage. Google Analytics, Google Ads and the Meta Pixel load only if you accept in the banner. They count how many people came from ads and signed up. What they collect is described in Google's and Meta's own policies.
Changed your mind? Clear this site's data in your browser and the banner comes back.

sections.title: Who gets the data
text: We sell nothing. Data passes only through the services the site needs to run:
list: Vercel: hosting for the site and its server functions.
Turso: the database with accounts and shelves.
IGDB (Twitch): the game catalog, which only receives search queries.
Steam: sign-in and library import, if you use them.
Your browser's push services (Google, Mozilla, Apple), if you turn on notifications.
Google and Meta, only after you accept in the banner.

sections.title: How long we keep it
text: Your account and shelf stay until you delete them. The visit log is cleared after 120 days.

sections.title: Your rights
text: Your data is visible on your account page. You can change your password there and delete your account at any time. Deletion erases the account, shelf, comments and notification subscriptions immediately and for good. The visit log keeps its entries without your name.
